description: AI grader / LLM-as-judge with rubric — Score any text (an LLM answer, essay, email, support reply, summary) against your rubric: each criterion gets a 1-10 score with a one-line reason, weighted overall score, PASS / REVISE / FAIL verdict against your threshold, blocking criteria, strengths, weaknesses and specific fixes. Optional task= (what the writer was asked) and reference= (ideal answer) for correctness checks, pass= threshold (default 7). Use it to evaluate agent outputs or gate content before sending. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

rubric.description: optional criteria separated by ; (append :2 to weight), e.g. accuracy:2;clarity;tone

name: ai_grade
